content: Zendesk dark mode: agents choose Dark/Light/Match system appearance from profile Appearance; admin toggle; applies to Support (tickets, views), not Admin Center; conversation has separate View in dark/light; internalnote (2025-03-24) reports dark bg #151A1E, text #D8DCDE, Garden ThemeProvider colors.base; a known issue where match-system with OS auto is always dark. No documented DOM marker for dark mode.
